Claim 1 (Currently amended): A preventing or treating agent for glaucoma comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is formulated to reduce intraocular pressure in a subject diagnosed with glaucoma or at risk of developing glaucoma.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): A preventing or treating agent for ocular hypertension comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof, wherein the agent is formulated to reduce intraocular pressure.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): A composition for eye drops comprising (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof and a pharmaceutically accepted carrier, wherein the composition is formulated to reduce intraocular pressure in a subject with elevated intraocular pressure.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): A method for treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject diagnosed with glaucoma.

Claim 8 (Cancelled).

Claim 9 (Previously presented).

Claim 10 (Previously presented).

Claim 11 (Currently amended): A method for enhancing an intraocular pressure-reducing action of (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or its salt in a subject with elevated intraocular pressure, wherein phosphoric acid or a salt thereof is combined with (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof.

Claim 12 (Previously presented).
